name: unschedule
sql: do $$ begin perform cron.unschedule('stale_watch_10min'); exception when others then null; end $$; select 'unscheduled' as result

name: drop
sql: drop schema if exists stale_watch cascade; delete from vault.secrets where name in ('stale_watch_telegram_bot_token', 'stale_watch_telegram_chat_id'); select 'dropped' as result
